integrity.checker: verify.py reproduces all pair classifications through four tips and the exact five-tip witness with exhaustive survivor-set enumeration.
integrity.proof: Exact edge-indicator identity, least-common-ancestor split analysis, quadratic root criterion, and explicit rational witness.

scientific_limitations: The result is for a finite rooted full-binary tree of strictly positive, possibly unequal and non-ultrametric edge lengths.
Only independent identical background species-survival probabilities, complete protection of one species, and equal action costs are considered.
No claim is made about optimal multiple-species portfolios, correlated extinction, field risk estimates, or actual species-management recommendations.
Historical priority is evaluated against inspected sources and searches, not exhaustively certified.
title: Five taxa are sharp for re-entrant single-species conservation priority
